params.name: include_full_response
params.description: Whether to return the full eligibility response from the payer. Defaults to `false` when not provided.

items.docs:
Verify a member's current insurance coverage and benefits. You can access detailed information including a member’s progress on their Deductible and Out-of-pocket, as well as Copay and Coinsurance information for different services.

#### Example Use Case
Inform a member of their current progress against their Deductible as well as their Copay and Coinsurance summaries so they can better estimate their out-of pocket costs.

items.docs: Search or list all insurance partners supported by our eligibility features.

params.description: The identifier for this insurance partner in the Ribbon API

items.docs: Fetch an insurance partner supported by our eligibility features.

params.name: procedure_ids
params.description: The UUIDs of the procedures to filter results to, as a comma-delimited string

params.name: member_zip
params.description: The zip code of the member we are generating cost estimates for

params.name: type
params.description: The type of data to base cost estimates on: `claims` data or payer-filed `price_transparency` data. Defaults to `claims`.

params.name: plan_id
params.description: The UUID of the insurance plan to use when fetching negotiated rates with providers. Necessary only if searching for estimates using the 'price_transparency' `type`.

items.docs:
Calculates estimated costs for a given procedure based on a user's location.

#### Example Use Case
Estimate the cost of a knee replacement surgery for a user in Boston so they can plan their personal finances accordingly.
